article.title: 更進新聞：Supermetrics廣告操作加入ChatGPT Ads
article.title_en: Follow-up: Supermetrics adds ChatGPT Ads to campaign management
article.summary: 公司更正後的公告列出七個廣告平台，ChatGPT Ads是較早六平台名單之外的新增項目。
article.summary_en: The corrected release lists seven ad platforms. ChatGPT Ads is the addition to the earlier six-platform list.
highlights: Campaign Management提供可配置審批、權限及預算限制。
公司亦列出變更記錄，供團隊追蹤改動。
highlights_en: Campaign Management offers configurable approvals, permissions and budget limits.
The company also lists a change log for oversight.
article.why: 代理商可在同一工作流程分析和執行廣告調整，實際可用操作仍需按平台查核。
article.why_en: Agencies can link analysis to execution while checking available actions by platform.
article.next_step: 先查閱帳戶可用權限，指定審批人和預算上限，再以非上線活動驗證改動紀錄。
article.next_step_en: Confirm account permissions, approvers and budget limits, then check the log in a non-live campaign.
article.detail: 先前公布的Claude廣告操作涵蓋六個平台。新公告把ChatGPT Ads列入名單，並說明團隊可配置審批、預算限制及權限。各渠道可用的改動類型與預設規則仍要逐項確認。若團隊原有人工核准規則，應先在測試活動查清楚誰能提出、批准與執行改動，以及記錄會保留甚麼資料。
article.detail_en: The earlier Claude announcement covered six platforms. The new release lists ChatGPT Ads and describes configurable approvals, permissions and budget limits. Check supported actions and defaults by channel. Use a test campaign to verify who can propose, approve and execute changes, and what the log records.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
article.followup: 11月4日版報道Claude廣告操作涵蓋六個平台。這次的新發展是支援名單加入ChatGPT Ads。
article.followup_en: Our November 4 edition covered six platforms for Claude campaign actions. ChatGPT Ads is the new addition.
